Max volumetric speed 18 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Sold as 'Hyper PLA RFID Lightweight'. Active-foaming PLA. Spec block image: 210-270C, bed 45-60C, 40-100 mm/s, fan 100%, raw density 1.2 g/cm3, MFI 8.1 (190C/2.16kg), tensile 18 MPa, elongation 3.4%. Printed density depends on nozzle temp (Creality table): 210C 1.2 / 220C 1.08 / 230C 0.9 / 240C 0.66 / 250C 0.6 / 260C 0.54 g/cm3; marketing 'about 0.8 g/cm3'. Creality foaming guide (gallery image): nozzle 230-270C, bed 40-60C, print speed 30-60 mm/s, dry 60-80C for 4-6 h before printing; page copy: 'foaming ratio adjusts with temperature (230-270C)'. US spool label: 190-270C. Drying recorded from the foaming guide (60C lower bound, 6 h upper bound; full range 60-80C / 4-6 h). Expect to tune flow ratio down for foaming.
Source: https://store.creality.com/products/hyper-lightweight-pla-3d-printing-filament-1kg
